title: Email verified but person not clinically proofed
evidence: A verified email does not make a person proofed: guardians and family links need a staff check (test_family.py). Identity proofing itself is not built.

title: Recovery through compromised contact
evidence: Account recovery is a single-use, one-hour link to the verified email (test_email.py, test_change_password.py). A compromised contact is not detected.

title: Token issued to wrong audience or expired
evidence: test_auth.py: an expired, tampered or foreign-key token is refused.

title: Clinician SSO success with inactive regional license
evidence: Patient matching, break-glass emergency access, single sign-on and the other identity-assurance machinery of this specification are not built.

title: Workload token used as human proxy
evidence: A partner's credential can only post signed partner messages and cannot act as a person (test_partner_events.py).

title: Foreign global account presents valid login
evidence: A login belongs to one customer and a token fixes it (test_auth.py, test_rls.py). There are no global accounts.

title: Guardian lacks verified legal basis for minor
evidence: A guardian is approved by a staff member who must say what kind of proof they saw and where it is kept; both are recorded and audited (test_family.py). The legal basis is still the staff member's word: nothing here verifies the document or ties a kind of proof to a relationship.

title: Minor age threshold changes under market rule
evidence: Patient matching, break-glass emergency access, single sign-on and the other identity-assurance machinery of this specification are not built.

title: Patient revokes caregiver with active session
evidence: A guardian's access is checked live on every request, so revoking takes effect at once (test_grant_states.py, test_guardian_scope.py).

title: Proxy allowed scheduling but requests notes
evidence: test_guardian_scope.py: a guardian sees only the parts the clinic granted (appointments, messages, referrals, insurance) and never records.

title: Employer sponsor requests individual lab result
evidence: test_prohibitions.py: the employer role is barred from patient data whatever else is true.

title: Clinician moves facilities
evidence: test_clinician.py: a doctor's care link is tied to the clinic site and ends when they leave it.

title: Facility license or provider contract suspended
evidence: test_suspensions.py: a suspended customer's staff are refused at once, and it takes two different support people.

title: Nurse has staff role but no current care assignment
evidence: test_site_patients.py: staff reach only the patients who have dealings with their own site.

title: Support agent tries emergency clinical access
evidence: test_prohibitions.py: support is barred from patient data and messages, and no emergency access exists.

title: Approved OAuth scope with missing lawful-purpose flow
evidence: A doctor states a purpose that the rules check against their role (test_purpose.py). There is no OAuth.

title: Patient can be inferred by query timing or error text
